scope: Historical modules 0.2.6 internal-eMMC experiment on the original Duet SKU176: short ordinary-app camera checks and restoration of recorded targets; not whole-filesystem equality or general hardware certification

environment.board: Lenovo IdeaPad Duet Chromebook, original SKU176

build.interpretation: The build-only record is preserved unchanged. This separate record describes later hardware observations; compilation does not itself prove recognition, capture or image quality.

installation.boot_preparation_scope: At this revision camera DT and isolation were prepared and restored in a separate boot procedure; the package updater handled packages and runtime settings only.

sensor_recognition.evidence: The accepted ordinary-app run selected each prepared camera route and acquired a JPEG from each. This is runtime recognition evidence, separate from the build result.

sequence: ordinary switch to rear and rear JPEG
normal quit, new process, rear JPEG
image_acquisition.dimension_check_scope: JPEG header metadata only; dimensions are saved-image dimensions, not a measured frame rate or proof of native sensor resolution.

human_image_quality.evidence: A limited visual check of saved camera output found no major abnormality.
human_image_quality.scope: Limited visual observation; no quantitative image-quality assessment, full autofocus calibration or long-term guarantee.

live_dt_review.layout_verification: A compiled C offsetof/sizeof check against the fixed public header confirms the two offsets, uint64 field sizes and 1096-byte structure.
live_dt_review.disposition: The sole live-DT difference is confined to the two kernel-selection benchmark timer fields. Both property headers and all other 3056 bytes match. The original strict rejection was preserved, and a separately reviewed checker with only this narrow additional exception passed on the restored device.
live_dt_review.limits: The public ABI identifies these fields; it does not establish the exact installed firmware source commit, timer units, or the cause of the timing difference. Raw DT byte equality remains false.

user_session_runtime_observation.interpretation: Process presence matches the original observation. PipeWire and WirePlumber were explicitly started during the final check; this does not establish autostart or audio functionality.

limitations: This is a short camera run, not endurance or long-term stability validation.
Measured frame rate, full autofocus calibration, quantitative image quality, audible audio and suspend/resume are not established by this record.
Original depmod output was not captured; its original byte equality cannot be proved.
Whole-filesystem equality is not assessed. Unrecorded package payloads, home files, logs, caches, timestamps, ACLs and xattrs are outside the exact restoration claim.
Block I/O counters, module-list bytes and SCP runtime state may vary across boots.
PipeWire and WirePlumber were manually started for the final runtime observation; automatic user-service startup, audio device availability and audible audio remain unverified.

privacy.public_hash_scope: Only distributable source and P1 module hashes are included; no device-baseline or photograph hashes.
